OUR PASSION

SERVE FIRST

We want to help local charities through our 5 Point Zero Ambassadors. To let you know how important charitable giving is to us, we launched our charity program called “Serve First” within 30 days of launching the business. Jonathan hosted the first “Serve First” event (a 12-hour pickleball marathon) and raised $5,000 for a local suicide prevention hotline. We can’t support every request, but if a pickleball charity event is important to one of our active Ambassadors, it is important to us. If you want to SERVE your local community, join our team.


BECOME A 5 POINT ZERO AMBASSADOR

settings.text: We love everything about pickleball: the culture, the comradery, the community, and the friendly competition. Bring 5 Point Zero out to the court as your new favorite playing partner.
At 5 Point Zero, we focus on creating high-quality sports drinks that enhance performance, boost focus, and improve hydration, ensuring pickleball players achieve their best results.
